responsibility: This file implements simple string-oriented terminal I/O on top of StdIO for the mc-boot runtime. It writes lines and nul-terminated arrays, reads an input line into a caller buffer with built-in line editing for backspace, kill-line, and erase-word control characters, and conditionally echoes through the active StdIO output path, making it the user-facing string stream layer above single-character I/O.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the runtime implementation in the GStrIO pair: it defines the line-editing input behavior, echo helpers, and output routines on top of StdIO, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStrIO.h only declares the public string-I/O procedures.
